content.comment_body: Hello everyone, here's what I've done so far: [product_name] device is connected to WiFi/router using an Ethernet cable. Initially, I connected the [product_name] to my PC via Ethernet and set the IP to 192.168.0.3. After connecting [product_name] to the router, my PC (on the same network via WiFi) accessed 192.168.0.3 in the browser with no issues. However, trying the same IP from my laptop and mobile browser didn't work. Does anyone know why this might be happening?
Did you make sure the web server is enabled? How do you usually set up and access the web server on [product_name] version [version_no]?

No matter what I try, I can't get it running. Here’s my process: 1. Connected [product_name] to PC via Ethernet; device got IP 192.168.0.3. 2. Uploaded my program via Ethernet. 3. Disconnected [product_name] from PC, installed on electrical board, and attached via Ethernet to WiFi router. 4. Attempted to connect from the same PC over WiFi using 192.168.0.3, but got an error that the devices weren't on the same subnet, so tried updating the IP. 5. Approved the change, got new IP 192.168.0.251, and it connected. 6. Navigated to menu for Ethernet settings. 7. Checked "Assign IP address"—details: IP: 192.168.0.3, Subnet mask: 255.255.255.0, Gateway: 192.168.0.1. 8. Reviewed Web server access settings, enabled HTTP access. 9. Tried connecting from smartphone and laptop to several IPs like 192.168.0.3, 192.168.0.3:8080, 192.168.0.251—but no luck. Any suggestions?

This probably happens because your WLAN card has an IP address from a different subnet than 192.168.0.x. Every device that wants to connect to the [product_name] must use IPs within the same 192.168.0 network.

That seems to be the problem. However, how do I resolve it? All devices using WiFi get IPs in the 192.168.1.xxx range, but [product_name] is on 192.168.0.3. Should I go into "Assign IP address" and choose new IP settings? If so, should subnet mask be 255.255.255.0 and gateway be 192.168.1.1 (router address)?
Assign the [product_name] an IP within the range, e.g., 192.168.1.3, and set the gateway as 192.168.1.1.

Hi, I set the [product_name] IP to 192.168.1.100 and the gateway to 192.168.1.1. Tried connecting from laptop and mobile—now it works! However, I can’t see the graphical interface (LWE). When I connect, I only get the main menu page (see attached screenshot). The LWE file has already been uploaded to [product_name]. How do I access the graphical control screen of LWE directly from [product_name] to control its inputs? Typing 192.168.1.100 always takes me to the main menu.
Could you provide a screenshot of the login page?
Are you asking about the page I see just after entering 192.168.1.100? See the attached screenshot.
Adjust your settings as shown in the screenshot I provided.

Thanks, everything works perfectly now! Is there a way for the client or user to be sent directly to the graphical LWE page, without ticking "Customize site" and "Keep me logged on", meaning only access the graphical environment and not the [product_name] main menu?
To my knowledge, that's not possible.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced networking issues when trying to access the graphical environment of [product_name] web editor remotely, mainly due to mismatched IP subnets between devices and the [product_name]. Even after correcting the IP settings, users struggled to find a clear method to access the graphical control interface directly. The troubleshooting process required several steps and was not particularly intuitive, with limited guidance from product feedback.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to connect to their [product_name] device from various devices on the network and immediately access the graphical control environment in the web browser, with minimal steps or technical hurdles.
